source.notes: Primary source only. Comparison sources checked; no facts imported.

episode_only.identity_digest: Late-20s to early-30s Korean office worker; ordinary non-glamorous appearance; simple office-casual clothing; natural everyday hairstyle; visibly distinct from Gaeun, Harin and Taemin; same face, hair and outfit across all four slides.

slides.action: worker_01 casually clears advertisement chat rooms on a private smartphone in a repetitive routine rhythm
scene_facts: worker_01 is alone and casually cleaning advertisement chat rooms on a private smartphone
worker_01 looks at the actual phone display while using it
camera prioritizes the worker and hand action; the audience sees the phone back or edge rather than an impossible readable front display
office background is simple and subordinate to the character
no readable messenger text, room names, captions, logos or speech bubbles are baked into raster art
slides.story_clarity: This must read as an ordinary repetitive cleanup action before any mistake is recognized.
forbidden_entities: phone display visible from an impossible front-camera geometry
slides.composition: medium shot or medium-close three-quarter view; worker reaction and tapping action primary; keep device naturally oriented toward worker_01, not toward audience
slides.visual_delta_from_previous: opening slide establishes routine cleanup with no prior state

screen_contract.subject_screen_relation: worker_01 is looking at the front display while operating it
screen_contract.camera_screen_relation: front or front-three-quarter camera on the opposite side of the display plane; audience sees phone back/edge, not readable display
screen_contract.geometry_contract: The physical display faces worker_01. Do not rotate or mirror the phone so both worker_01 and the front camera can read the same private display. Screen information is not required in this slide.

slides.beat: silence after one wrong exit action
slides.action: after one more routine deletion/exit gesture, worker_01's hand stops and the face shifts from neutral routine to a small frozen hesitation
scene_facts: worker_01 identity, hair and outfit remain exactly continuous from slide 1
the same private phone remains naturally oriented toward worker_01
the hand has just stopped after a routine cleanup gesture
expression is a subtle 'something is wrong' pause, not yet panic
no readable UI or explanatory text is baked into raster art
slides.story_clarity: The reader should feel a tiny break in rhythm before knowing exactly what went wrong.
slides.composition: slightly tighter than slide 1; character reaction primary while phone remains secondary and physically natural
slides.visual_delta_from_previous: routine tapping stops; neutral face becomes a small frozen hesitation

screen_contract.subject_screen_relation: worker_01 remains oriented to the front display
screen_contract.camera_screen_relation: reaction-led front/three-quarter view; physical display need not be visible to audience
screen_contract.geometry_contract: Preserve the phone's real front/back orientation from slide 1. Audience readability is not required and must not force an impossible presentation pose.

slides.beat: 어 — 팀방이 사라졌고 4년치 업무 히스토리와 사진의 손실 규모를 시각적으로 인지
slides.action: worker_01 freezes as the missing team room is recognized; visual-only information communicates roughly four years of accumulated work history and work photos being lost
scene_facts: worker_01 identity, hair and outfit remain exactly continuous from prior slides
worker_01 says only '어' later in editable lettering; raster contains no dialogue
the physical phone stays naturally oriented toward worker_01 and is not turned toward the audience
the four-year work-history/photo loss is carried by a separate editable UI/information overlay zone, not by explanatory dialogue and not by impossible physical phone geometry
the visual treatment should feel like a sudden concrete realization, not fantasy destruction or melodramatic explosion
slides.story_clarity: One beat must simultaneously reveal that the wrong room was the team room and make the four-year accumulated loss feel concrete without explanatory speech.
slides.composition: reaction-led medium-close shot with deliberate negative/overlay space; character remains primary, UI/information is secondary and added in composition stage
slides.visual_delta_from_previous: hesitation becomes full recognition and the hidden stakes become visually concrete

screen_contract.subject_screen_relation: worker_01 is looking at the private front display
screen_contract.camera_screen_relation: reaction camera does not require physical display readability; information is delivered through a separate vector inset/overlay
screen_contract.geometry_contract: Keep the phone physically believable and facing worker_01. The audience receives team-room/loss information through editable vector UI/information graphics, never by rotating the private screen into an impossible shared-view pose.

slides.action: worker_01 breaks into a hollow laugh while tears gather or fall, conveying devastated amusement rather than melodramatic sobbing
scene_facts: worker_01 identity, hair and outfit remain exactly continuous
final performance combines tears with a hollow involuntary laugh
expression is devastated and absurdly resigned, not polished sadness and not exaggerated gag-face comedy
phone is secondary or out of frame; no screen information is needed
no readable text or speech bubble is baked into raster art
slides.story_clarity: The final image should land on the human residue of 'this is so bad I can only laugh' rather than a punchline or moral.
slides.composition: medium close-up prioritizing face and upper-body performance; phone may be lowered or outside the important visual area
slides.visual_delta_from_previous: frozen recognition releases into a hollow crying-laugh reaction
